source_candidates.title: Pre-production
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Supports a preproduction order where character, prop, location, storyboard, animatic, and color styling guide storyboard rows before any final render.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Grounds the idea that a visual master board is pre-shot guidance, not a new story fact source.

source_candidates.title: How to Create an Animatic
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Animatic timing maps confirmed storyboard rows to panel timing, action legibility, camera simulation, and provisional sound/dialogue without creating new dialogue.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports duration-based panel count suggestions without forcing fixed 8 or 9 frame grids.

source_candidates.title: Storyboard Pro Panel View
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Panel-level dialogue and notes can inform a future storyboard image export while preserving accepted dialogue and existing row fields.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Clarifies that panel notes are export guidance, not a mandate to add new final fields.

source_candidates.title: Producer Assets
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Character sheets, model references, backgrounds, props, and similar production assets support continuity boards.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Grounds character, prop, and background references as audit/continuity assets rather than automatic runtime payloads.

source_candidates.title: Storyboard Composition - Layout, Format, and Framing
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Supports shot size, camera movement, framing, and composition as explicit per-panel choices.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Helps guard against repetitive multi-panel composition by requiring each panel to carry a visible shot function.

source_candidates.title: Gen-4 Image References Guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Reference images can preserve characteristics, styles, characters, objects, and locations across generated images.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports a future reference board handoff while keeping PWA as storyboard owner.

source_candidates.title: Image to Video Prompting Guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: For image-to-video, the image defines composition, subject, lighting, and style, while text focuses on motion, camera work, and temporal progression.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Separates visual reference content from motion instructions in storyboard image/video handoff.

source_candidates.title: Text to Video Prompting Guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Supports clear separation of visual components and motion components for prompt_text compilation.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Useful for storyboard prompt order without importing model-specific prompt templates.

source_candidates.title: Veo on Vertex AI video generation prompt guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Veo prompt anatomy maps subject, action, scene, camera angles, camera movements, lighting, ambiance, temporal elements, and dialogue.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Provides field-compatible vocabulary for camera, shot size, scene context, action, and timing.

source_candidates.title: Best practices for Veo on Vertex AI
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: For image-to-video, source image quality matters and the prompt should focus on motion rather than redundantly describing the image.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports storyboard image export boundary: reference board supplies look; text supplies movement and visible change.

source_candidates.title: Video generation with Sora
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Effective video prompts describe shot type, subject, action, setting, and lighting; image references can guide first-frame look and asset consistency.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports a future export handoff while keeping copyrighted characters, public figures, faces in input images, and automatic video promises out of scope.

source_candidates.title: GPT Image 2 model
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Official model reference confirms image generation and editing support with image inputs, which is enough for future reference-board export research.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Confirms image-board output remains a separate optional artifact, not a replacement for PWA storyboard rows.

source_candidates.title: Seedance
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Official page describes text/image to video and multi-shot consistency across subject, style, atmosphere, and transitions.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports why Hope should prepare field-bound shot planning, but does not justify one-click video generation promises.

source_candidates.title: Seedance 1.0: Exploring the Boundaries of Video Generation Models
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Technical report highlights native multi-shot generation, instruction adherence, spatiotemporal fluidity, and subject consistency.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports multi-shot planning and continuity guards as knowledge candidates, not direct runtime integration.

source_candidates.title: CANVAS: Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Continuity-aware visual storyboarding emphasizes character continuity, persistent background anchors, location-aware planning, and prop consistency.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Research backing for prop/environment continuity and frame-to-frame consistency checks.

source_candidates.title: VibeFrame
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Separates STORYBOARD and DESIGN intent files, validates storyboard plans, and tracks cost/review before generation.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Product reference for keeping design/reference board separate from shot rows and generated assets.

source_candidates.title: Jellyfish - AI Short Drama Studio
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Treats consistency as first-class with centralized character, scene, prop, and costume management linked to shot preparation.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports asset-continuity candidates while preserving Hope's existing row fields.

source_candidates.title: OpenMontage
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Shows reference-video-to-production-plan and checkpointed tool-path thinking, useful only as product-structure reference.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports a handoff boundary that reports tool path and cost/feasibility instead of promising automatic video generation.

source_candidates.title: Director's Console
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Storyboard canvas and print storyboard layout are useful product-structure references for a confirmable board export lane.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports native confirmation queue thinking, but style/preset/IP-like content must be blocked from runtime.

source_candidates.title: Awesome AI Video Prompting
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Useful only to locate official guides and categories; not a direct rule source.
source_candidates.kb_gap: FutureQA source index only.

source_candidates.kb_gap: 补充国内视频模型的图生视频和一致性证据。

source_candidates.title: Image generation guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Supports image generation with prompt, image inputs, reference images, multi-turn editing, masks, and quality/size parameters.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Grounds Image2 export as structured visual prompt guidance, not an automatic generation promise.

source_candidates.title: Gen-4 Image Prompting Guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Runway organizes image prompts by subject, scene, composition, lighting, color, style, focus, angle, text, and mood; it also warns against unsupported negative phrasing.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports structured prompt modules and a boundary against dumping negative-word lists.

source_candidates.title: How to make an AI image with a text prompt
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Runway frames effective text-to-image prompting around subject, context, style, and technical details.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports modular routing by image use case instead of a single fixed template.

source_candidates.title: Prompt Basics
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Midjourney recommends clear, specific prompts, concrete counts, and focusing on what should appear rather than long confusing instructions.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports rejecting generic quality stacking and ambiguous lists.

source_candidates.title: Quality parameter
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Quality controls processing/detail behavior but is parameter-like and model-specific; it does not replace content, composition, lighting, or material instructions.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports the quality preset boundary.

source_candidates.title: No parameter
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: The no parameter is a concise exclusion mechanism and has parsing/moderation caveats.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports concise forbidden-item handling rather than a huge negative prompt dictionary.

source_candidates.title: Prompt and image attribute guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Google recommends clear prompts with subject, context/background, style, lighting, and iteration; it also distinguishes negative prompts where supported.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports structured prompt organization and explicit negative boundaries.

source_candidates.title: Edit images overview
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Imagen editing uses targeted mask-based edits such as inserting objects, removing objects, expanding content, and replacing backgrounds.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports local repair as a selected-area operation, not a full-scene rewrite.

source_candidates.title: Omit content using a negative prompt
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Google describes negative prompts as an omission aid, recommends plain terms, and notes model-version support limits.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports FutureQA for provider-specific negative prompt semantics.

source_candidates.title: Writing effective text prompts
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Adobe recommends direct descriptive prompts with subject, descriptors, and keywords, and rewording prompts iteratively when results miss the target.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports structured prompt refinement without copying fixed templates.

source_candidates.title: Use Generative Fill
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Generative Fill uses a brush-selected area plus text prompt and optional reference image to add or replace local content while maintaining visual consistency.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports local repair prompt boundaries and reference-based edits.

source_candidates.title: Using Generate Image with Image5
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Adobe Firefly Services distinguishes text-to-image from prompt-driven edits to an existing image while preserving structure and composition.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports FutureQA for API use while keeping current KB candidate summary-only.

source_candidates.title: Stability AI API parameters
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Stability documents prompt, dimensions, safety filtering, CFG scale, and generation parameters as separate controls.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports keeping quality/settings separate from PWA row facts.

source_candidates.title: Multi-prompting
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Stability documents prompt weights and negative weights as bounded generation controls.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports careful negative constraint handling but not runtime negative-word dumping.

source_candidates.title: Text-to-image prompt guide
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Alibaba Cloud documents prompt and negative_prompt as separate image generation controls.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports domestic official coverage for structured positive/negative controls.

source_candidates.title: Wan image editing model
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Wan image editing documentation describes editing prompts and negative prompts for unwanted blur, extra fingers, or other local defects.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports image repair as a separate future module, not current PWA field mutation.

source_candidates.title: CogView-4
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: CogView-4 official docs emphasize semantic understanding, image quality, bilingual prompts, and complex instruction following benchmarks.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports domestic official coverage for prompt adherence and quality claims.

source_candidates.title: ComfyUI Inpainting Workflow
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: ComfyUI inpainting examples frame defect repair and detail optimization as masked/local workflows.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports local repair boundary and open-source workflow reference.

source_candidates.title: ComfyUI
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: ComfyUI is a node-based image generation engine with prompt workflows, image editing models, and inpainting workflows.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Auxiliary evidence for modular image prompt workflows only.

source_candidates.title: ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: The project targets masked-area inpainting by cropping, repairing, and stitching back into the image.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Auxiliary support for preserving the rest of the image during local repair.

source_candidates.title: Awesome AI Image Generator Prompts
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Curated prompt resources group image prompt patterns, negative prompt ideas, and workflow examples.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Auxiliary only; does not define runtime rules.

source_candidates.title: Understanding the Basic Principles of Graphic Design
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Adobe design basics explain emphasis, hierarchy, visual weight, and balance as core composition principles.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports visual hierarchy candidates for poster/group composition.

source_candidates.title: Design Composition: Layout, Balance, and Visual Flow
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: The guide explains primary focal point, secondary and tertiary supporting elements, balance, grid, flow, and contrast.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports first/second/third visual layer prompts and density limits.

source_candidates.title: Visual hierarchy in a research poster
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Poster guidance separates primary, secondary, and tertiary importance with focal point, flow, proportion, balance, whitespace, and grid.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports group poster density and hierarchy guard.

source_candidates.title: Texture and Material Prompts for AI Image Generation
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: Material prompts should specify material type, surface finish, physical properties, color, lighting, and technical constraints.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports material, reflection, and dark-area cleanliness candidates.

source_candidates.title: Prompt-Propose-Verify: Hand-Object Interaction Data Generation
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: The paper identifies hands and hand-object interactions as persistent failure points and uses a propose/verify framework for reliable HOI generation.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports explicit hand-object contact integrity requirements.

source_candidates.title: Interact-Custom: Customized Human Object Interaction Image Generation
source_candidates.pwa_relevance: The paper addresses identity preservation and interaction control by modeling spatial configurations between human and object.
source_candidates.kb_gap: Supports prompt rules for contact points, grip, occlusion, and object placement.
